items.source:
Get the keyId to use. The value must resolve to either the UUID representation of the key or a base64 encoded value representing the UUID value.
On ElementType.TYPE level the keyId() can be left empty if explicitly set for fields.
On ElementType.FIELD level the keyId() can be left empty if inherited from encryptMetadata.
items.translation:
获取要使用的 `keyId`。其值必须解析为密钥的 UUID 表示形式，或代表该 UUID 值的 base64 编码字符串。
在 ElementType.TYPE 级别，如果字段已显式设置 `keyId()`，则可以将其留空。
在 ElementType.FIELD 级别，如果 `keyId()` 是从 `encryptMetadata` 继承的，则可以将其留空。

items.source:
Set the algorithm to use.
On ElementType.TYPE level the algorithm() can be left empty if explicitly set for fields.
On ElementType.FIELD level the algorithm() can be left empty if inherited from encryptMetadata.
items.translation:
设置要使用的算法。
在ElementType.TYPE级别，如果字段已显式设置，则algorithm()可以留空。
在ElementType.FIELD级别，如果从 encryptMetadata 继承，则algorithm()可以留空。

items.source:
Encrypted provides data required for MongoDB Client Side Field Level Encryption that is applied during schema resolution. It can be applied on top level (typically those types annotated with Document to provide the encryptMetadata. 
@Document
@Encrypted(keyId = "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==")
public class Patient {
         private ObjectId id;
         private String name;

         @Field("publisher_ac")
         @DocumentReference(lookup = "{ 'acronym' : ?#{#target} }") private Publisher publisher;
}

"encryptMetadata": {
   "keyId": [
     {
       "$binary": {
         "base64": "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==",
         "subType": "04"
       }
     }
   ]
 }

On property level it is used for deriving field specific encrypt settings. 
public class Patient {
         private ObjectId id;
         private String name;

         @Encrypted(keyId = "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==", algorithm = "AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_512-Deterministic")
         private String ssn;
}

"ssn" : {
  "encrypt": {
     "keyId": [
       {
         "$binary": {
           "base64": "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==",
           "subType": "04"
         }
       }
     ],
     "algorithm" : "AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_512-Deterministic",
     "bsonType" : "string"
   }
 }
items.translation:
Encrypted 提供了在模式解析期间应用于 MongoDB 客户端字段级加密所需的数据。它可以应用于顶层（通常是带有 Document 注解的类型），以提供 encryptMetadata。 
@Document
@Encrypted(keyId = "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==")
public class Patient {
         private ObjectId id;
         private String name;

         @Field("publisher_ac")
         @DocumentReference(lookup = "{ 'acronym' : ?#{#target} }") private Publisher publisher;
}

"encryptMetadata": {
   "keyId": [
     {
       "$binary": {
         "base64": "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==",
         "subType": "04"
       }
     }
   ]
 }

在属性级别，它用于派生特定字段的加密设置。 
public class Patient {
         private ObjectId id;
         private String name;

         @Encrypted(keyId = "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==", algorithm = "AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_512-Deterministic")
         private String ssn;
}

"ssn" : {
  "encrypt": {
     "keyId": [
       {
         "$binary": {
           "base64": "4fPYFM9qSgyRAjgQ2u+IMQ==",
           "subType": "04"
         }
       }
     ],
     "algorithm" : "AEAD_AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_512-Deterministic",
     "bsonType" : "string"
   }
 }

items.source: the key id to use. May contain a parsable expression. In this case the #target variable will hold the target element name.
items.translation: 要使用的键 ID。可以包含可解析的expression。在这种情况下，#target变量将持有目标元素名称。
